prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a cute, comical giraffe version of a chubby yellow baby dragon caught in an enormous, uncontrollable laugh. Give it a plump round body, a long gently curved giraffe neck, golden-yellow fur with large irregular brown giraffe patches, two short ossicones, little ears, tiny arms and legs, a small tail, and subtle baby-dragon wings. Its eyes are squeezed shut, its mouth is wide open in a joyful laugh, and its round cheeks are lifted; one hand presses against its belly as it laughs. Keep the pose lively and the expression unmistakably delighted. Bright, polished 3D cartoon character art, soft warm lighting, appealing smooth textures, clear silhouette, centered full-body composition, simple uncluttered pale background. No words, captions, logos, or extra characters.
